metadata.description: Generate a lipsync avatar video from an image and an audio file using HeyGen's Avatar IV engine.
Translate a video into one or more languages with lip-sync and voice preservation via HeyGen.
Upscale and/or retime a video with Topaz Labs (Proteus, Iris, Artemis, Nyx; Chronos/Apollo frame interpolation).
Upscale and restore a still image with Topaz Labs, with face recovery for lipsync-quality head crops.
Edit an image from a prompt + reference images (Nano Banana 2/Pro, GPT Image 2) via WaveSpeed.
Generate a talking video from an image and an audio file via WaveSpeed InfiniteTalk.
Relipsync an existing video to a new audio track via WaveSpeed InfiniteTalk video-to-video.
Detect the head in a video and emit a square crop region for face-swap prep.
Crop the detected head region out of a video as a square clip (swap intermediate).
Composite the swapped head region back onto the original plate video.
Crop a head-and-shoulders zoom from a full-body image, for a higher-quality lipsync pass.
Overlay a zoomed-in lipsync video over the full-body version, auto-aligned by face.
Composite a subject video over a background image or video, keying or matting as needed.
Shared shot settings (aspect, resolution, expressiveness) wired to every node that must agree on them.
Upload a media artifact to a DigitalOcean Spaces bucket and return its public URL.
Paste an enhanced face crop back onto the full-body source image, feathered, color-matched, and auto-aligned by face when a detection of the enhanced image is wired in.
Blend the bottom band of a full-frame AI edit (e.g. an added floor reflection) over the original image, feathered only along the top seam.
Extract a soft-alpha matte and RGBA cutout from a still image using rembg/BiRefNet, locally — white = subject, ready for Resolve/Nuke or the Composite nodes.
Run the SCAIL Infinite ComfyUI workflow on RunComfy: image + prompts + motion video, optional LoRA and size, cancellable polling, returns the output video URL.
